name: Advanced Scheduler
description: Scheduled moderation states to publish or un-publish content.
project_description:
This module is basically an enhancement of scheduler. It provides user to publish all contents having workbench moderation states. So it has dependencies with Scheduler and Workbench moderation module both. You need to configure the states (ie. draft, needs_review) according to requirements so that content having only the configured states would be publish during cron job execution.

 Dependencies: 

 - Scheduler https://www.drupal.org/project/scheduler 

- Workbench moderation https://www.drupal.org/project/workbench_moderation 

 Steps: 

 1- You need to install Advanced scheduler with all dependencies.

2- Create moderation states according to your requirements.

3- Configure your required moderation state to schedule content so that scheduler would publish configured states content during cron job execution.

 To configure scheduled moderation states go through given below link 

 http://example.com/admin/config/content/scheduler/scheduled-states
